summary: Algorithmic reverb (Hall, Room, Chamber, Plate) with pre-delay, size, decay, damping, modulation, freeze and shimmer. Use it for space and depth, best on a send at 100% wet.
use_for: Algorithmic reverb with hall, room, chamber and plate spaces, freeze and a sidechain.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: Algorithm: delay lengths, diffusion and early reflections
parameters.how: Chooses the reverb algorithm: Hall, Room, Chamber or Plate.
parameters.sound: Hall is big and smooth, Room is small and natural, Chamber is dense and even, and Plate is bright and fast to build up.

parameters.name: Pre-delay
parameters.how: Sets the gap before the reverb starts, from 0 to 250 ms.
parameters.sound: A longer gap keeps the dry sound clear in front of the tail and adds a sense of distance.

parameters.name: Size
parameters.description: Scales the space (delay lengths and reflections)
parameters.how: Scales the size of the space from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: Small values sound like a tight room and large values like a vast hall.

parameters.name: Decay
parameters.description: Reverb time (T60) in the mid band
parameters.how: Sets how long the tail lasts, from 0.2 to 30 seconds.
parameters.sound: Short decays add a touch of space and long ones wash the sound out into a wide atmosphere.

parameters.name: Low decay
parameters.description: Low-frequency decay time relative to the mid band
parameters.how: Sets how long the low frequencies ring compared with the mids, from a quarter to four times.
parameters.sound: Below 1x the lows die away fast and stay clean, and above 1x they linger and rumble.

parameters.name: High damping
parameters.description: Above this, the tail decays four times faster
parameters.how: Sets the frequency above which the tail dies out four times faster, from 1 to 20 kHz.
parameters.sound: Lower values make a dark, soft tail and higher values a bright, airy one.

parameters.name: Diffusion
parameters.how: Sets how densely the echoes build up, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: High diffusion is smooth and creamy, and low diffusion lets the individual echoes be heard.

parameters.name: Mod depth
parameters.description: Movement in the tail (breaks up metallic ringing)
parameters.how: Sets the amount of movement in the tail, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: A little breaks up metallic ringing, and a lot gives a lush, chorused wash.

parameters.name: Mod rate
parameters.how: Sets the speed of the tail movement, from 0.05 to 5 Hz.
parameters.sound: Slow rates are barely noticeable, faster ones add a visible shimmer.

parameters.name: Freeze
parameters.description: Holds the tail forever and stops taking input
parameters.how: Holds the current tail forever and stops taking in new sound.
parameters.sound: It turns the reverb into a sustained pad that stays until you release it.

parameters.name: Shimmer
parameters.description: Feeds the tail back an octave up
parameters.how: Feeds the tail back an octave higher, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: The tail climbs upwards in a bright, angelic glow.

parameters.name: Early
parameters.how: Sets the level of the early reflections, from -40 to +6 dB, or off.
parameters.sound: More early reflections place the sound in a definite room, fewer leave it more diffuse.

parameters.name: Late
parameters.how: Sets the level of the late tail, from -40 to +6 dB, or off.
parameters.sound: A higher tail sounds more spacious, and a lower one keeps the reverb tight.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.how: Sets the stereo width of the reverb, from 0 to 150 %.
parameters.sound: A low width is focused in the middle, and a high width is wide and enveloping.

parameters.name: Low cut
parameters.how: Removes low frequencies from the reverb, from 10 Hz to 1 kHz.
parameters.sound: Raising it keeps the reverb from muddying the bass.

parameters.name: High cut
parameters.how: Rolls off high frequencies of the reverb, from 1 to 22 kHz.
parameters.sound: Lowering it softens the reverb so it sits behind the dry sound.

parameters.name: Mix
parameters.how: Blends the dry sound with the reverb from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: Use a low value as an insert, or 100 % when the reverb sits on a send.
